jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Role Description

The Senior Financial Analyst is a full-time, on-site role based in Al Khobar. This position is responsible for preparing, analyzing, and interpreting financial statements to support decision-making and strategic planning. Day-to-day tasks include developing financial models, conducting variance and trend analyses, supporting budgeting and forecasting, and preparing regular financial reports for leadership. The Senior Financial Analyst collaborates with project teams to evaluate project profitability, assess financial risks, and ensure accurate tracking of costs and revenues. The role also involves improving financial processes, maintaining compliance with internal controls, and providing clear financial insights to non-finance stakeholders. The Senior Financial Analyst should also be responsible for assessing financing requirements, building relationships with banks, and involved in preparing the investment strategies.

Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong skills in Finance, Financial Planning, and Financial Reporting.
Candidates should possess strong skills in analyzing Financial Statements and applying Analytical Skills to support business decisions.
Relevant bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CFA, CPA) are an advantage.
Experience in financial analysis within construction, real estate, or project-based environments is preferred.
Proficiency with financial modeling tools and spreadsheet software; familiarity with ERP or accounting systems is beneficial.
Ability to present complex financial information clearly, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
